g.text: A standalone job and its callbacks (evilflowers-worker#5, 2026-11-16)
[raises, or past MAX_DELIVERIES (on_capped writes a failed outcome, then raises)]
No result backend: Celery sends the callback as a message (only chords need a backend). The errback is declared with bind=True,
so it is always applied as a task with the failed task id. The return value stays compact: it is the link's first argument.
